messages.snippet: Daniel, Isla, Rebecca, I'm pleased to confirm completion of the acquisition of Cedarbridge Business
messages.subject: Project Cedar - COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel, Isla, Rebecca,

I'm pleased to confirm completion of the acquisition of Cedarbridge Business Park this afternoon. Thornbury Properties is now the owner. The executed sale contract is attached for your records; the executed TR1, rent deposit deed and tenant notices are on the file. We'll submit the SDLT return (£702,000), apply to register the transfer at HM Land Registry, serve the tenant notices and chase the bank's discharge.

Congratulations to the team - it's been a pleasure.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
